dz: 光武帝称帝为"中华皇帝",在短命的新罗王朝倒台后恢复了汉朝.
de: Guangwu claims the throne as Emperor of China, restoring the Han dynasty after the collapse of the short-lived Xin dynasty.

t: 汉光武帝定都洛阳，为东汉王朝的首都。
te: Luoyang is declared capital of the Eastern Han dynasty by Emperor Guangwu of Han.
dz: 汉光武帝定都洛阳，为东汉王朝的首都。
de: Luoyang is declared capital of the Eastern Han dynasty by Emperor Guangwu of Han.
